# Harmonium

> Ship products, not utility classes. A complete React design system out of the box.

Harmonium is a React design system: typed components on Base UI primitives, themed with CSS custom properties, with accessible defaults. Version 9.0.0-alpha.4.

## Docs

- [Full API reference](https://revelrylabs.github.io/harmonium/llms-full.txt): props, types, defaults and examples for every component. Also in the npm package at `node_modules/harmonium/llms-full.txt`, matching the installed version.
- [Storybook](https://revelrylabs.github.io/harmonium/): interactive docs
- [GitHub](https://github.com/revelrylabs/harmonium): source and issues

## Quick start

- Install: `npm install harmonium@next` (v9 is in pre-release; `npm install harmonium` installs v8)
- Import: `import {Button} from 'harmonium'` or `import {Button} from 'harmonium/button'`
- Styles: `import 'harmonium/styles.css'` once in your app entry
- Theme: override `--harmonium-*` CSS custom properties

## Components

### Layout
- Stack (`harmonium/stack`): Lays out items in a column (or a row with `direction="horizontal"`) with consistent gaps.
- Group (`harmonium/group`): Lays out items in a row.
- Grid (`harmonium/grid`): A CSS grid. With GridCol.
- Separator (`harmonium/separator`): A horizontal or vertical divider (`<hr>`).
- Container (`harmonium/container`): Centers content with a max width and horizontal padding.
- AppShell (`harmonium/app-shell`): Page layout grid with header, sidebar, main and footer areas. With AppShellHeader, AppShellSidebar, AppShellMain, AppShellFooter.
- Sidebar (`harmonium/sidebar`): Side navigation: a `<nav>` of `SidebarSection`s and `SidebarItem`s. With SidebarSection, SidebarItem.
- Show (`harmonium/show`): Shows its children only at some screen widths, using the `breakpoints` (sm 640px, md 768px, lg 1024px, xl 1280px).

### Typography
- Text (`harmonium/typography`): Body text with size, weight and color variants.
- Heading (`harmonium/typography`): A heading.

### Forms
- Field (`harmonium/field`): Groups a form control with its label, description and error, and wires them up for assistive technology: `FieldLabel`'s `htmlFor` points at the control, and the control's `aria-describedby` lists the description and error that are rendered. With FieldLabel, FieldDescription, FieldError, useFieldContext.
- Input (`harmonium/input`): A native `<input>`.
- Textarea (`harmonium/textarea`): A native `<textarea>`, wired to the surrounding `<Field>`.
- Select (`harmonium/select`): A native `<select>`, wired to the surrounding `<Field>`.
- Checkbox (`harmonium/checkbox`): A checkbox with a label.
- Radio (`harmonium/radio`): A radio button with a label, used inside a `RadioGroup`. With RadioGroup.
- Switch (`harmonium/switch`): An on/off switch with a label.
- Slider (`harmonium/slider`): A range slider; `showValue` shows the current value next to it.
- NumberInput (`harmonium/number-input`): A number input with decrement and increment buttons.
- Combobox (`harmonium/combobox`): A searchable single-select: typing filters `options`, arrow keys move through them and Enter picks one.
- DatePicker (`harmonium/date-picker`): A native `<input type="date">`, wired to the surrounding `<Field>`.
- TimePicker (`harmonium/time-picker`): A native `<input type="time">`, wired to the surrounding `<Field>`.
- FileUpload (`harmonium/file-upload`): A drop zone that also opens the file picker on click, Enter or Space.
- MultiSelect (`harmonium/multi-select`): A searchable multi-select.

### Actions
- Button (`harmonium/button`): A native `<button>` with variants and sizes.
- ToggleGroup (`harmonium/toggle-group`): A set of toggle buttons where one is selected, like a segmented control. With ToggleGroupItem.

### Display
- Card (`harmonium/card`): A content container, with optional `CardHeader`, `CardBody` and `CardFooter` sections. With CardHeader, CardBody, CardFooter.
- Badge (`harmonium/badge`): A short status label.
- Alert (`harmonium/alert`): A message banner.
- Progress (`harmonium/progress`): A progress bar (`role="progressbar"`).
- Spinner (`harmonium/spinner`): A loading indicator, announced as `role="status"` with `label`.
- Avatar (`harmonium/avatar`): A user's picture, or `fallback` text (usually initials) when there's no `src` or the image fails to load.
- Skeleton (`harmonium/skeleton`): A pulsing placeholder shown while content loads.
- Tag (`harmonium/tag`): A label for a category, filter or selection.
- EmptyState (`harmonium/empty-state`): A placeholder for when there's nothing to show yet: icon, title, description and an action.
- Stat (`harmonium/stat`): A key metric: label, value and an optional change colored by `trend`.

### Navigation
- Tabs (`harmonium/tabs`): Tabbed panels: one `TabsContent` shows at a time. With TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent.
- Accordion (`harmonium/accordion`): Expandable sections. With AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent.
- Breadcrumbs (`harmonium/breadcrumbs`): A breadcrumb trail: a `<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">` with an ordered list of `BreadcrumbItem`s and a decorative separator between them. With BreadcrumbItem.
- Pagination (`harmonium/pagination`): Previous/next buttons and page numbers.
- TopBar (`harmonium/top-bar`): An application header bar (`<header>`) with `TopBarSection`s aligned left, center or right. With TopBarSection.

### Data
- Table (`harmonium/table`): A semantic HTML table built from `TableHead`, `TableBody`, `TableRow`, `TableHeader` (`<th>`) and `TableCell` (`<td>`). With TableHead, TableBody, TableRow, TableHeader, TableCell.
- DataGrid (`harmonium/data-grid`): A table driven by `columns` and `data`.

### Overlays
- Dialog (`harmonium/dialog`): A modal dialog, rendered in a portal on `document.body`. With DialogHeader, DialogBody, DialogFooter.
- Drawer (`harmonium/drawer`): A modal panel that slides in from the left or right edge.
- Tooltip (`harmonium/tooltip`): A short description shown when its child is hovered or focused.
- Popover (`harmonium/popover`): Floating content that opens when its child is clicked.
- Menu (`harmonium/menu`): A list of actions. With MenuItem, MenuSeparator, MenuLabel.
- CommandPalette (`harmonium/command-palette`): A modal, searchable command list (the "Command-K" pattern).

### Feedback
- ToastProvider (`harmonium/toast`): Shows the toasts created with `useToast()`; wrap your app in it once.
- useToast (`harmonium/toast`): Shows toasts from anywhere inside a `ToastProvider`.

### Wizard
- Stepper (`harmonium/stepper`): Progress through a multi-step flow. With Step.

### Marketing
- PricingTable (`harmonium/pricing-table`): A responsive row of `PricingCard`s, one per plan. With PricingCard, PricingCardHeader, PricingCardPrice, PricingCardFeatures, PricingCardFeature, PricingCardFooter.
